cohorts.name: Active writers
cohorts.summary: did document_created in the last 1209600 seconds
sql:
SELECT u.pid FROM (SELECT DISTINCT ue.pid FROM (SELECT e.*,
    CASE WHEN e.user_id IS NOT NULL AND e.user_id <> '' THEN e.user_id ELSE COALESCE(i.person_id, e.person_id) END AS pid,
    CASE WHEN e.user_id IS NOT NULL AND e.user_id <> '' THEN e.user_id ELSE COALESCE(i.person_id, e.person_id) END AS actor
  FROM events e
  LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT distinct_id, MIN(person_id) AS person_id
    FROM identities
    WHERE project = 'demo'
    GROUP BY distinct_id
  ) i ON i.distinct_id = e.distinct_id
  WHERE e.project = 'demo'
    AND e.ts_ms >= 1793814916104
    AND e.ts_ms < 1795024576104) ue) u WHERE (u.pid IN (SELECT pe.pid FROM (SELECT e.*,
    CASE WHEN e.user_id IS NOT NULL AND e.user_id <> '' THEN e.user_id ELSE COALESCE(i.person_id, e.person_id) END AS pid,
    CASE WHEN e.user_id IS NOT NULL AND e.user_id <> '' THEN e.user_id ELSE COALESCE(i.person_id, e.person_id) END AS actor
  FROM events e
  LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT distinct_id, MIN(person_id) AS person_id
    FROM identities
    WHERE project = 'demo'
    GROUP BY distinct_id
  ) i ON i.distinct_id = e.distinct_id
  WHERE e.project = 'demo'
    AND e.ts_ms >= 1793814916104
    AND e.ts_ms < 1795024576104
    AND e.event IN ('document_created')) pe GROUP BY pe.pid HAVING COUNT(*) >= 1))
